decisions_requested.statement: Validate REV-001..020 as two review activities for each of the ten already validated OPI, reusing only validated L01 question payloads and response contracts.
Validate REV-021 and REV-022 as integrative interviews composed only from already validated OPI payloads, with all original context and authority boundaries preserved.
Preserve YA/ES unresolved semantics, VANI WATCH with Master meaning null, VAME GATE, SARASALA/VAMAVALA/VAMAZAMU WATCH, ON GATE and KUVAN/KUON/VALA/NE CANDIDATE without authority promotion.
Confirm VAMUSARO remains rest/leisure period rather than a literal weekend lexeme and OPI10 remains an approximate contextual equivalent; no generic HNK DO, WITH or universal WH grammar is created.

Confirm the entire 22-slot Review lane is new governed v1.1 pedagogy rather than recovered historical Review payload, and that validation would close L01 at 155/155 without promoting language or visual canon.
